verdict.rationale: An IP office with online search and e-filing services could plausibly offer API access with scoped credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only web databases, filing software and signature-card or no-card filing routes, with no mention of API credentials, scopes or least-privilege tokens for agents. Signature cards authenticate a human filer and are not scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
